items.desc: Events, socials, trips, and sports — including a soccer league — for Muslim women 16+.

items.title: MusFit
items.desc: Basketball league, kickboxing & self-defense classes, plus coffee socials and a seniors movement program.

items.title: ISNA Canada
items.ownedBy: Women's programs led by Muslim women
items.desc: Women's badminton, sisters' programs, and family socials.

items.title: Muslim Girls Toronto
items.desc: Connecting Muslim girls in downtown Toronto through meetups and events.

items.title: Toronto Muslimahs
items.desc: Curated, intentional gatherings for Muslim women — including a space for new/young mothers.

items.title: ConnectHER Canada
items.desc: A badminton league plus recreational, social and confidence-building programs.

items.title: KORAA
items.desc: Sports + community programming — a bit further out than Mississauga/Oakville, but worth knowing about.

items.title: Muslimah Hockey Club
items.ownedBy: Run by a Muslim woman (contact: Humaira S.)
items.desc: A hockey program creating a safe space for Muslim women and girls (ages 4–52+) to learn and play ice hockey.

items.title: WomensFitSauga (WFS)

items.desc: Mississauga's all-women run club — beginner-friendly, weekly runs.

items.desc: A Toronto run/strength community — co-hosted the RUN4GAZA 5K fundraiser with WFS.

items.desc: Public details are limited — confirm current programs directly via Instagram.
